name: Sinsara
description: Sinsara was a dangerous and minor planet in the Anoat sector within the Outer Rim. It had a mysterious connection with Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn's past. In the years before the Invasion of Naboo, the assassin Corlis Rath attempted to kill Jinn for a reason involving Sinsara.
